description: Two prose lines inside a run that also holds declarations: each is E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT at its own line; the declarations around them survive. (The native front end used to leave the first as a raw parse-error cascade and the second unreported, because a declaration flagged by the cascade exempted the group.)
rationale: §40.8 S441 bullet: one E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT per maximal run of statements that are not valid code, which raise no other diagnostic. Found by the S441 round-4 fuzz.
